about: Deliberate accessible-name changes of rebuilt controls (tools/smoke56.test.js). Each rule rewrites a baseline control's name before it is looked up; its recorded effects must still match exactly.

rules.why: M4 shell: the subject pill is named by its label; the per-subject percentage no longer prints (the Graphite sub-nav shows a colour dot).
M4 shell: the rail profile chip has an explicit name instead of its concatenated text.
M4 primitives: a tab with a kanji mark is named by its label; the hint became the tooltip.
